items.title: Wild Flourish Scroll DXF Panel for Abstract Wall Art
items.description: Loose, asymmetric scrollwork bursts across the panel like windblown foliage, mixing sharp leaf points with soft curling stems. The free-flowing composition gives it a more artistic, less symmetrical feel than a typical damask.

items.title: Bubble Circle DXF Pattern for Playful Abstract Screens
items.description: Circles of varying sizes cluster and overlap loosely across the panel like rising bubbles or falling raindrops. The random, playful scale variation suits contemporary lounges, cafe screens, and doors wanting a relaxed modern feel.
